about: Synthetic surface forms for the companion linguist (Model -1). Frames use {slot} placeholders of the runtime intent catalog; pool entries give a canonical English value and surface forms per language. A plain string is verbatim in every language. eval_frames never appear in training. Swiss German frames may name dialect nodes (<node>, dialect_lexicon.json), realized per region.
